description.value: Upper Canyon Open Space is a nature reserve managed by the City of Kelowna, situated in the upper canyon area of the city. As a publicly accessible open space, it offers natural terrain that may appeal to cyclists looking to explore Kelowna's canyon landscapes on foot or by trail. The area is part of Kelowna's parks and beaches network.
